role_in_parent: Analytic bottleneck: the derivative sign on the rescaled cell.
statement_nl: For every positive integer n, every integer j with 0 <= j <= n - 1, and every real t with 0 < t < 1, one has F_n'(T_{n,j}(t)) <= 0.

domain_restrictions: j is an integer with 0 <= j <= n - 1
t is a real number with 0 < t < 1
T_{n,j}(t) is defined for the given n, j, and t
F_n is differentiable at x equals T_{n,j}(t) so that F_n'(T_{n,j}(t)) is defined
statement_semantic_sketch.normalized_claim: For every positive integer n, for every integer j with 0 <= j <= n - 1, and for every real t with 0 < t < 1, if x equals T_{n,j}(t), then the derivative F_n'(x) exists and satisfies F_n'(T_{n,j}(t)) <= 0.

variables.name: n
variables.role: index parameter for the function F_n and the family T_{n,j}

variables.name: j
variables.role: index parameter choosing a member of the family T_{n,j}

variables.domain: subset of the domain of F_n where the derivative exists
variables.name: x
variables.role: the point at which the derivative F_n' is evaluated, defined by x equals T_{n,j}(t)

witness_dependencies: none (the statement is universally quantified; there are no existential witnesses)
